vendor_name: NordFrame Logistics GmbH Internal RFP Document / Vendor Draft
executive_summary: The submitted document is structurally framed as an RFP requirement list rather than a vendor proposal submission, yet it contains core architectural intents. While it correctly identifies key functional needs such as a web dashboard, low-stock alerts, and role-based access control, it lacks formal vendor commitments regarding cloud scalability, SLA guarantees, and explicit commercial pricing within the €80k-€120k budget envelope.
strengths: Explicitly targets multi-warehouse visibility across 6 regional sites.
Identifies the need for role-based access control separating regional managers from HQ staff.
Defines clear implementation milestones including a 3-month pilot and 6-month full rollout.
weaknesses_and_gaps: Submitted document reads like an RFP specification rather than a vendor's responsive bid.
Fails to explicitly detail cloud-based scalable architecture (REQ-04).
Lacks concrete technical specifications for PostgreSQL database integration and SLA metrics.

scorecard.evaluation_notes: Proposal specifies a web-based dashboard showing real-time inventory levels across all 6 warehouses.
Role-based access is detailed, mapping warehouse managers to their specific sites and HQ staff to all sites.
Automated low-stock alerts sent to managers based on configurable thresholds are included.
Implied through web-based delivery and database integration, but lacks explicit cloud infrastructure and scalability commitments.
